description: Imports and Exports Control Department - Imports and Exports Control Regulations No. 20 of 2022 (Reserved)
categorisation: This gazette content primarily involves the promulgation of new regulations under the Imports and Exports Control Act, specifically amending the Special Imports License Regulations. It establishes legal/regulatory frameworks for import control exemptions for aircraft parts, which falls under legal/regulatory matters rather than government personnel or structural changes.
